description:
Claim PoX-5 sBTC rewards for one reward cycle through the staker's signer manager. If the manager has not yet pulled that cycle's rewards from pox-5, this first sends the manager's permissionless claim-rewards (a second transaction, paid by this wallet), then the staker claim. Rewards arrive as sBTC, or as a BTC withdrawal if a payout address was set when staking. Not available for managers that pay off-chain.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

signerManager.description: Signer manager to claim from. Defaults to the wallet's current signer manager.

name: claim_stacking_rewards
